state_transitions.reason: swarm_audit: path traversal vulnerability in SpecService — accepts arbitrary projectPath without validation (SW-001)
swarm_audit: terminal WebSocket protocol mismatch — server sends 'output' but client expects 'terminal:output' with payload wrapper (SW-002)
swarm_audit: terminal router has no user isolation — any authenticated user can access any terminal session (SW-003)
swarm_audit: learning router has no ownership checks — IDOR vulnerability allows any user to read/modify/delete others' learnings (SW-004)

new_backlog_items.title: Fix: SpecService path traversal vulnerability
new_backlog_items.description: SpecService accepts arbitrary projectPath without validation, allowing path traversal. Add validatePath() from FSService or implement equivalent protection. Evidence: spec.ts:17,29, spec-service.ts:39,52.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix: Terminal WebSocket protocol mismatch (server vs client)
new_backlog_items.description: Server sends { type: 'output', data } but client expects { type: 'terminal:output', payload: { data } }. Align message format between websocket.ts and use-terminal.ts. Evidence: websocket.ts:27, use-terminal.ts:52-53.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix: Terminal router missing user isolation
new_backlog_items.description: Terminal operations (create, write, resize, kill, list) don't check user ownership. Add userId to TerminalSession interface and filter by user. Evidence: terminal.ts:18,24,31,52, terminal-service.ts:4.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix: Learning router missing ownership checks
new_backlog_items.description: Learning list/get/update/delete accept any ID without ownership verification. Add user filter to all operations. Evidence: learning.ts:60,72,97,107.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix: Auto-mode endpoints missing ownership checks
new_backlog_items.description: stop, status, setConcurrency, setConfig, getConfig endpoints have no user/project ownership checks. AutoModeService singleton only supports one user. Evidence: auto-mode.ts:60,66,72,86.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix: Notification markRead/dismiss missing ownership checks
new_backlog_items.description: markRead and dismiss endpoints accept any notification ID without ownership verification. Other notification endpoints correctly check. Evidence: notifications.ts:50,67.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix: Feature bulkCreate/bulkDelete lack transaction wrapping
new_backlog_items.description: Sequential loops without transactions mean partial failures leave inconsistent state. Errors silently swallowed. Evidence: feature.ts:203,224,231.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix: Kanban board missing 'failed' status column
new_backlog_items.description: KANBAN_COLUMNS omits 'failed' status — features with failed status disappear from the board. Evidence: kanban-board.tsx:35,40.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix: Devtools rendered unconditionally in production
new_backlog_items.description: TanStack Router and React Query devtools are always rendered, no import.meta.env.DEV guard. Evidence: __root.tsx:99,100.

new_backlog_items.title: Fix: Session list fetches ALL sessions then filters client-side
new_backlog_items.description: AgentService.listSessions() and session router both return findAll() then filter by userId. Should filter at database query level. Evidence: agent.ts:96, session.ts:91.

new_antipatterns.name: websocket_protocol_mismatch
new_antipatterns.description: Server and client WebSocket handlers using different message type strings and payload structures. No shared type definition enforces consistency.
new_antipatterns.example: Server sends { type: 'output' }, client checks data.type === 'terminal:output'
new_antipatterns.impact: Feature appears implemented (code compiles, no errors) but data never reaches the UI

new_antipatterns.name: inconsistent_authorization_checks
new_antipatterns.description: Some endpoints in a router check ownership, others in the same router don't. Creates false sense of security.
new_antipatterns.example: notifications.ts: list/countUnread check ownership, markRead/dismiss don't
new_antipatterns.impact: IDOR vulnerabilities in endpoints that skip checks

new_antipatterns.name: global_fetch_then_filter
new_antipatterns.description: Fetching all records with findAll() then filtering in the router/handler instead of querying with WHERE clause.
new_antipatterns.example: service.listSessions() returns ALL, router filters by userId
new_antipatterns.impact: Performance degradation at scale, temporary data exposure
